candidates.title: Budget review deadline negotiation
candidates.setting: A short planning call on Thursday morning about the Q3 budget review deadline; the finance team has asked for the draft two days earlier than originally agreed.
candidates.goal: Agree on a realistic date for the budget review draft while acknowledging the finance team's scheduling pressure.

candidates.title: Client demo scope meeting
candidates.setting: A Friday afternoon meeting where the client has asked to add two features to next week's demo, and the engineering team is already at capacity.
candidates.goal: Reach a shared decision on which demo features to keep, showing that the client's request is understood while protecting the team's capacity.
